summary: Frontend-only regression testing on Hi Tours Egypt package detail page (/afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub) at 1440 desktop and 390 mobile emulation. All 11 requested checks passed. No console errors, no horizontal overflow, correct CTA counts, correct ratings placement, correct 'What's included' items, expert title & Instrument Serif quote, stacked itinerary with scroll-spy + sticky header + tab click scroll, accommodation cards + Customise CTAs, Blush summary button revealing 5 glance days with valid photos, reviews heading/summary, sticky bar content, listing page loads cleanly.
verified_checks: Desktop 1440 & mobile 390: 0 console errors; scrollW == clientW at 390 (no horizontal overflow)
eg-detail-head has no eg-detail-cta and no 'Plan for free' text
PriceCard (desktop eg-detail-sidebar and mobile eg-detail-mobile-price) has exactly 1 eg-detail-price-cta 'Plan for free'; mobile first-viewport visible 'Plan for free' count = 1
eg-ratings-row is inside eg-detail-price; NOT inside eg-detail-experts/experts-mobile/features; eg-trust-row not present
eg-price-services has 6 li in correct order (Hotels, Transfers, Activities, Entry tickets, 24/7 support, Holiday expert-led customisation); each has an svg; no eSIM/Flights/app text

eg-expert-title = 'Trip created by Ria Banerjee, our product head and destination expert for Egypt'; eg-expert-quote font-size=22px, family='Instrument Serif, Georgia, serif'; toggle works (line-clamp-2 removed on open)
5 stacked eg-route-section-0..4 all in DOM with names Cairo/Nile Cruise/Luxor/Hurghada/Cairo; eg-route-text has webkitLineClamp=3, height≈60px @ 20px line-height; Show more expands to full text

Scroll-spy: section 2 top ≈130 → tab 2 selected (aria-selected=true, others false); section 4 top ≈100 → tab 4 selected. eg-route-header stays sticky (top=0). Clicking eg-route-tab-1 from top scrolls section 1 top to ~88-120px range and marks tab 1 selected

5 accommodation cards with correct names (Semiramis, M/S Concerto Plus, Marriott, Marriott, Semiramis); eg-accommodation-cta text 'Customise this'; eg-activities-cta text 'Customise activities'; mobile 'Your accommodation' heading not truncated (scrollW == clientW)

eg-route-summary-cta background = rgb(250, 221, 209) (Blush); click reveals eg-glance-days with 5 rows; every eg-glance-photo naturalWidth > 0; #summary scrolled to top≈-16px; desktop first column width (836) > accommodation/highlights column (260)

eg-reviews h2 = 'What customers say about booking Egypt with Hi Tours'; eg-review-summary contains 'Excellent', '4.8 out of 5', 'based on 420 Egypt reviews'; eg-detail-recommended heading 'Other Egypt holidays you may like' follows; footer present
Sticky bar text: 'Ria Banerjee & our team From ₹1,44,000 per person Plan for free'
critical_code_review_comments: Note: scroll-spy line is HEADER+24=144. Spec described 'section top at ~150px' selects that tab; in practice at exactly 150 the previous tab remains active (150 > 144). At 130 (well under the line) tab activation is correct. Behavior is acceptable and matches the intent when scrolling normally, but if strict 150 boundary is required, consider tightening the offset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All round-2 requirements for Egypt detail page verified passing on desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Scroll-spy line is HEADER(120)+24=144; use section top < 144 in tests, not exactly 150.
